<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>愜易居客戶及派遣管理系統</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.5.1/css/all.min.css" media="print" onload="this.media='all'; this.onload=null;" crossorigin="anonymous">
<style>
/* 基礎排版與滾動條 */
* {
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
box-sizing: border-box;
font-family: 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif;
}
body {
background: #f4f7fb;
color: #334155;
line-height: 1.6;
transition: background-color 0.4s ease;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; }
/* ====== 三大專區動態主題色彩 ====== */
/* 營業管理區 (翠綠) */
body.theme-business { background-color: #f0fdf4; }
body.theme-business .sidebar-header h1 { color: #10b981; }
body.theme-business .sidebar-nav a.active { background-color: #d1fae5; color: #10b981; border-right: 4px solid #10b981; }
body.theme-business .page-title i { color: #10b981; }
/* 人事管理區 (藍色) */
body.theme-hr { background-color: #eff6ff; }
body.theme-hr .sidebar-header h1 { color: #3b82f6; }
body.theme-hr .sidebar-nav a.active { background-color: #dbeafe; color: #3b82f6; border-right: 4px solid #3b82f6; }
body.theme-hr .page-title i { color: #3b82f6; }
/* 業務開發區 (紫色) */
body.theme-sales { background-color: #f5f3ff; }
body.theme-sales .sidebar-header h1 { color: #8b5cf6; }
body.theme-sales .sidebar-nav a.active { background-color: #ede9fe; color: #8b5cf6; border-right: 4px solid #8b5cf6; }
body.theme-sales .page-title i { color: #8b5cf6; }
/* 登入畫面 */
#login-screen {
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
background: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?q=80&w=2069&auto=format&fit=crop') center/cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e3a5f 40%, #0f4c32 100%);
background-color: #0f172a;
position: fixed;
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
z-index: 9998;
}
#login-screen::before {
content: '';
position: absolute;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(15,23,42,.65);
}
.login-box {
background: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
padding: 45px 40px;
border-radius: 16px;
box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
width: 100%;
max-width: 420px;
text-align: center;
position: relative;
z-index: 1;
border-top: 6px solid #2d9d5c;
}
.login-logo-container { margin-bottom: 20px; height: 80px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
.login-logo-container img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; display: none; }
#login-logo-icon { font-size: 50px; color: #2d9d5c; }
.login-box h1 { color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; }
.pro-badge { display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#d97706); color: white; padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 25px; }
.login-field { margin-bottom: 18px; text-align: left; }
.login-field label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; font-size: 13px; }
.login-field input, .login-field select { width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; outline: none; }
.btn-login { width: 100%; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#2d9d5c,#15803d); color: white; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 10px; }
/* 系統框架排版 */
.app-container, .staff-container { display: none; min-height: 100vh; }
.sidebar {
width: 240px;
background-color: #fff;
box-shadow: 2px 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,.03);
padding: 20px 0;
position: fixed;
height: 100vh;
overflow-y: auto;
z-index: 10;
border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.sidebar-header { padding: 0 20px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; margin-bottom: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; }
.sidebar-header img { max-height: 40px; margin-bottom: 10px; display: none; }
.sidebar-header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; transition: color 0.3s; }
.sidebar-nav { list-style: none; padding: 0 10px; }
.sidebar-nav li { margin: 4px 0; }
.sidebar-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 15px; color: #64748b; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s; }
.sidebar-nav a:hover { background-color: #f8fafc; color: #1e293b; }
.main-content {
flex: 1;
margin-left: 240px;
padding: 25px 35px;
width: calc(100% - 240px);
overflow-x: auto;
transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.page-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 25px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 15px; }
.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sys-time { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; background: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
#sync-status { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
.switch-role-btn { background: #fff; color: #3b82f6; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
.switch-role-btn:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
.workspace-direct-btn.active{background:#dbeafe!important;color:#1d4ed8!important;border-color:#93c5fd!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,235,.12);}
/* 頁面內容區塊 */
.page {
display: none;
background: #fff;
border-radius: 12px;
box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
padding: 30px;
margin-bottom: 20px;
border: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}
.page.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease; }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.page-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.filter-bar { background: #f8fafc; padding: 15px 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.filter-bar label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.filter-bar select, .filter-bar input { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 25px; }
.grid div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.grid label { margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #475569; }
.grid input, .grid select { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; }
.checkbox-group { display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; background: #fff; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; }
/* 按鈕與徽章 */
button.btn { padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; transition: 0.2s; }
button.btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); }
.btn-success { background: #10b981; }
.btn-warning { background: #f59e0b; }
.btn-excel { background: #3b82f6; }
.btn-pdf { background: #ef4444; }
.btn-backup { background: #8b5cf6; }
.btn-restore { background: #06b6d4; }
.btn-sync { background: #0ea5e9; }
.btn-sm { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 0; }
.btn-clear-filter { background: #94a3b8 !important; color: white !important; margin-left: 8px !important; margin-bottom: 0 !important; padding: 8px 12px !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; min-width: 800px; background: #fff; }
table th { padding: 14px 12px; background: #f8fafc; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; }
table td { padding: 12px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
.table-responsive { overflow-x: auto; width: 100%; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; }
.badge { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.badge-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.badge-red { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
.badge-blue { background: #dbeafe; color: #075985; }
.badge-yellow { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.pagination { margin-top: 20px; display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
.pagination button { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; }
/* 儀表板卡片 */
.dashboard-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
.dash-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 25px 20px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.dash-card.primary { border-top: 4px solid #3b82f6; }
.dash-card.success { border-top: 4px solid #10b981; }
.dash-card.danger { border-top: 4px solid #ef4444; }
.dash-card.warning { border-top: 4px solid #f59e0b; }
.dash-icon { position: absolute; right: -10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 80px; opacity: .05; }
.dash-card .label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px; z-index: 2; position: relative; }
.dash-card .num { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; color: #1e293b; z-index: 2; position: relative; }
#toast { display: none; position: fixed; top: 30px; right: 30px; background: #10b981; color: #fff; padding: 15px 25px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.5); z-index: 1000000; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; }
/* 報表預覽 */
#preview-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9); z-index: 99999; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px; }
#preview-header-bar { background: #fff; padding: 15px 25px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 0 auto 20px auto; max-width: 850px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
#preview-body { max-width: 850px; margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: 40px; }
.pdf-box { width: 100%; max-width: 794px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fff; padding: 35px; color: #333; font-family: 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
.pdf-box table { min-width: 0 !important; }
.section-divider { grid-column: span 4; margin-top: 15px; margin-bottom: 5px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #1e293b; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
/* 權限控制隱藏項目 (硬性鎖定) */
.workspace-business .ws-hr, .workspace-business .ws-sales { display: none !important; }
.workspace-hr .ws-business, .workspace-hr .ws-sales { display: none !important; }
.workspace-sales .ws-business, .workspace-sales .ws-hr { display: none !important; }
body.role-hr .sys-auth, body.role-sales .sys-auth { display: none !important; }
/* 📱 手機版 RWD 響應式排版 */
#mobile-menu-btn { display: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #2563eb); color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
/* ====== 智慧排班月曆模式 ====== */
.schedule-page-shell{background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;}
.schedule-topbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;}
.schedule-title-wrap h2{font-size:22px;color:#0f172a;margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:900;}
.schedule-title-wrap p{color:#64748b;font-size:13px;margin:0;}
.schedule-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.schedule-actions select{padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;font-weight:700;color:#334155;}
.schedule-kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:14px 0;}
.schedule-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:14px;padding:18px 16px;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.03);}
.schedule-kpi .mini-icon{width:34px;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:12px;background:#eef6ff;color:#2563eb;margin-bottom:10px;}
.schedule-kpi.red .mini-icon{background:#fff1f2;color:#dc2626;}
.schedule-kpi .kpi-label{font-size:13px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;}
.schedule-kpi .kpi-value{font-size:28px;color:#0f172a;font-weight:900;line-height:1.2;}
.schedule-controls-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;margin:14px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 260px;gap:16px;}
.schedule-legend{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.shift-pill{padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border:1px solid transparent;}
.shift-rest{background:#fff1f2;color:#ef4444;border-color:#fecaca;}
.shift-early{background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;border-color:#bfdbfe;}
.shift-mid{background:#fffbeb;color:#b45309;border-color:#fde68a;}
.shift-night{background:#ecfdf5;color:#059669;border-color:#a7f3d0;}
.shift-inside{background:#f8fafc;color:#475569;border-color:#e2e8f0;}
.shift-custom{background:#faf5ff;color:#9333ea;border-color:#e9d5ff;}
.schedule-rule-box{background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;}
.schedule-rule-box label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px;}
.schedule-rule-box input{width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.schedule-board-wrap{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;overflow:auto;max-height:68vh;}
.schedule-board{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;min-width:1180px;width:100%;font-size:12px;}
.schedule-board th,.schedule-board td{border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;}
.schedule-board th{background:#f8fafc;color:#64748b;font-weight:900;padding:9px 6px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:4;}
.staff-head,.staff-cell{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:5;background:#fff;min-width:82px;width:82px;box-shadow:1px 0 0 #e2e8f0;}
.staff-head{z-index:7;background:#f8fafc!important;}
.staff-cell{font-weight:900;color:#334155;}
.day-head{min-width:58px;height:58px;}
.day-head .num{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#64748b;}
.day-head .week{display:block;font-size:12px;}
.day-head .day-count{display:inline-block;margin-top:4px;background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.4;}
.day-head.weekend{background:#fff1f2;color:#ef4444;}
.schedule-cell{height:92px;min-width:58px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;padding:5px;transition:.15s;}
.schedule-cell:hover{background:#f8fafc;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #93c5fd;}
.shift-card{border-radius:9px;padding:7px 4px;line-height:1.25;min-height:58px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid;font-weight:900;}
.shift-card .code{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.shift-card .time,.shift-card .hours{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;}
.monthly-total{min-width:78px;color:#dc2626;font-weight:900;background:#fff;position:sticky;right:0;z-index:3;}
.pill-total{display:inline-block;background:#fff1f2;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 10px;color:#ef4444;line-height:1.45;}
.schedule-warning{margin:14px auto 0;width:max-content;max-width:100%;background:#ef4444;color:white;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(239,68,68,.25);}
.schedule-modal-backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);z-index:99999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
.schedule-modal{width:100%;max-width:620px;background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 25px 80px rgba(15,23,42,.35);padding:24px;}
.schedule-modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.schedule-modal-head h3{margin:0;color:#0f172a;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;}
.schedule-modal-sub{color:#64748b;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;}
.modal-shift-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.modal-shift-option{border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;font-weight:900;transition:.15s;}
.modal-shift-option:hover,.modal-shift-option.active{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);}
.modal-shift-option .small{display:block;font-size:12px;margin-top:3px;opacity:.8;}
.schedule-modal-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
.schedule-modal-form label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#475569;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:5px;}
.schedule-modal-form input{width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:10px;}
.schedule-modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px;}
.schedule-board .time-head,.schedule-board .time-cell{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:5;background:#fff;min-width:74px;width:74px;box-shadow:1px 0 0 #e2e8f0;font-weight:900;}
.schedule-board .time-head{z-index:7;background:#f8fafc!important;color:#475569;}
.schedule-board .slot-cell{height:74px;min-width:62px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;padding:6px;transition:.15s;vertical-align:top;}
.schedule-board .slot-cell:hover{background:#f8fafc;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #93c5fd;}
.slot-cell-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;text-align:left;}
.slot-staff-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;max-width:100%;background:#eff6ff;color:#1d4ed8;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.slot-person-card{width:100%;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-left:4px solid #3b82f6;border-radius:10px;padding:5px 6px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.04);font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;color:#334155;}
.slot-person-card .p-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#1d4ed8;margin-bottom:2px;}
.slot-person-card .p-time{font-weight:900;color:#0f172a;}
.slot-person-card .p-break{color:#b45309;font-weight:800;}
.slot-person-card .p-hours{color:#059669;font-weight:900;}
.slot-person-card.continue{opacity:.68;background:#f8fafc;border-left-color:#94a3b8;}
.slot-person-card.continue .p-name:after{content:' 續';color:#64748b;font-size:10px;}
.slot-count{display:inline-block;background:#e0f2fe;color:#0369a1;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:2px;}
.slot-empty{color:#cbd5e1;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.schedule-note-box{background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;color:#1e40af;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;}
.schedule-quick-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin:14px 0;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.03);}
.schedule-quick-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#0f172a;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:12px;}
.schedule-quick-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1.1fr .9fr .75fr .75fr .75fr .75fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:end;}
.schedule-quick-form label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#475569;margin-bottom:5px;}
.schedule-quick-form input{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;background:#fff;}
.schedule-quick-hint{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;}
.schedule-filled-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin:14px 0;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.03);}
.schedule-filled-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#0f172a;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:10px;}
.schedule-filled-panel table{width:100%;min-width:920px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;background:#fff;}
.schedule-filled-panel th{background:#f8fafc;color:#334155;font-weight:900;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;text-align:left;}
.schedule-filled-panel td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;color:#334155;}
.schedule-filled-empty{padding:18px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;text-align:center;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:10px;}
.schedule-mini-del{background:#ef4444;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;}
.schedule-mini-edit{background:#3b82f6;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;margin-right:6px;}
@media(max-width:1100px){.schedule-quick-form{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.schedule-quick-form .quick-full{grid-column:1/-1}}
.schedule-staff-check-panel{grid-column:1/-1;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;max-height:220px;overflow:auto;}
.schedule-staff-check-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#334155;margin-bottom:8px;}
.schedule-staff-check-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;}
.schedule-staff-check-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#334155;cursor:pointer;}
.schedule-staff-check-item:hover{border-color:#93c5fd;background:#eff6ff;}
.schedule-staff-check-item input{width:auto!important;margin:0;}
.schedule-conflict-box{grid-column:1/-1;display:none;background:#fff7ed;border:1px solid #fed7aa;color:#9a3412;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.6;}
@media(max-width:700px){.schedule-staff-check-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
@media(max-width:900px){.schedule-kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.schedule-controls-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.modal-shift-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:600px){.schedule-kpi-grid,.schedule-modal-form,.modal-shift-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* ===== 員工打卡總覽版面壓縮：移除上方大空白 ===== */
#page-clock_overview{
margin-top:0!important;
padding-top:18px!important;
min-height:auto!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .page-title{
margin-bottom:12px!important;
padding-bottom:10px!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .filter-bar{
margin-top:0!important;
margin-bottom:14px!important;
padding:12px 16px!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .dashboard-grid{
margin-top:0!important;
margin-bottom:14px!important;
gap:12px!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .dash-card{
padding:16px 18px!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .dash-card .num{
font-size:30px!important;
}
.workspace-direct-btn.active{
background:#1d4ed8!important;
color:#fff!important;
border-color:#1d4ed8!important;
}
#sync-status{
white-space:nowrap;
}
/* ===== 強制修正：員工打卡總覽上方空白 ===== */
#page-clock_overview{
display:none;
background:#fff!important;
border-radius:12px!important;
box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.05)!important;
padding:16px 22px!important;
margin:0 0 20px 0!important;
min-height:0!important;
height:auto!important;
border:1px solid #f1f5f9!important;
}
#page-clock_overview.active{display:block!important;}
#page-clock_overview .page-title{margin:0 0 12px 0!important;padding-bottom:10px!important;}
#page-clock_overview .filter-bar{margin:0 0 12px 0!important;padding:12px 16px!important;}
#page-clock_overview .dashboard-grid{margin:0 0 12px 0!important;gap:12px!important;}
#page-clock_overview .dash-card{padding:14px 16px!important;min-height:0!important;}
#page-clock_overview .dash-card .num{font-size:28px!important;}
#page-clock_overview .clock-hero,
#page-clock_overview .clock-banner,
#page-clock_overview .clock-empty-space,
#page-clock_overview .staff-clock-hero,
#page-clock_overview .staff-clock-spacer{display:none!important;height:0!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
.sidebar { left: -260px; transition: 0.3s all ease; z-index: 9999; }
.sidebar.open { left: 0; box-shadow: 10px 0 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
.main-content { margin-left: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; padding: 15px !important; }
.grid, .dashboard-grid, #fta_time_block { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
.page-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.header-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
.filter-bar { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
.filter-bar select, .filter-bar input { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 5px; }
#mobile-menu-btn { display: block; }
.quick-actions button { flex: 1 1 100%; margin-bottom: 10px !important; }
}
/* ===== 完整正式版：員工端打卡入口與總覽版面修正 ===== */
#page-clock_overview{
padding-top:12px!important;
margin-top:0!important;
min-height:auto!important;
height:auto!important;
}
#page-clock_overview .page-title{margin:0 0 12px 0!important;}
#page-clock_overview .filter-bar{margin-top:0!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
#page-clock_overview .dashboard-grid{margin-top:0!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
.clock-hero,.clock-banner,.clock-empty-space,.staff-clock-hero,.staff-clock-spacer{display:none!important;height:0!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;}
.staff-clock-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:18px;align-items:start;}
.staff-clock-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7f5;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.04);margin-bottom:14px;}
.staff-clock-card.today{border-top:4px solid #10b981;}
.staff-clock-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.staff-clock-title h3{margin:0;color:#0f172a;font-size:17px;font-weight:900;}
.staff-clock-meta{font-size:13px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;line-height:1.7;}
.staff-clock-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;}
.staff-clock-actions button{margin:0!important;}
.staff-clock-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;}
.staff-clock-status.none{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;}
.staff-clock-status.in{background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8;}
.staff-clock-status.done{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;}
.staff-clock-status.abnormal{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;}
.staff-clock-empty{background:#f8fafc;border:1px dashed #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;padding:24px;text-align:center;color:#64748b;font-weight:900;}
.staff-clock-tips{background:#eff6ff;border-left:4px solid #3b82f6;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;color:#334155;line-height:1.9;font-size:14px;}
@media(max-width:900px){.staff-clock-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
/* ===== GPS打卡與主管審核欄位 ===== */
.gps-badge{display:inline-block;background:#ecfdf5;color:#047857;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;}
.gps-badge.missing{background:#fff1f2;color:#be123c;border-color:#fecaca;}
.device-text{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.45;max-width:180px;white-space:normal;word-break:break-all;}
.staff-clock-gps{margin-top:8px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;color:#475569;line-height:1.7;}
.gps-warning{background:#fff7ed;border:1px solid #fed7aa;color:#9a3412;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;}
.clock-overview-table th,.clock-overview-table td{vertical-align:top;}
/* ===== 派遣人員資料庫：新增 / 修改分頁 + 彈窗 ===== */
.staff-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 18px;}
.staff-tab-btn{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#fff;color:#334155;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.05);}
.staff-tab-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);}
.staff-tab-btn.active{background:#1d4ed8;border-color:#1d4ed8;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(29,78,216,.18);}
.staff-panel{display:none;}.staff-panel.active{display:block;}
.staff-split-note{background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;color:#1e3a8a;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.7;}
.staff-sub-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.staff-list-box{background:#fff;padding:18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;}
.staff-edit-modal-backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.58);z-index:100000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;overflow:auto;}
.staff-edit-modal{width:min(1080px,96vw);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgba(15,23,42,.35);padding:24px;border:1px solid #dbe4f0;}
.staff-edit-modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.staff-edit-modal-head h3{margin:0;color:#0f172a;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;}
.staff-edit-modal-head p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;}
.staff-edit-modal-close{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#fff;color:#334155;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;}
.staff-edit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;background:#fafafa;padding:20px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;}
.staff-edit-grid label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#334155;margin-bottom:6px;}
.staff-edit-grid input,.staff-edit-grid select{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;}
.staff-edit-divider{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;font-weight:900;color:#1e293b;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:12px 0 8px;margin-top:4px;}
.staff-edit-wide{grid-column:1/-1;}.staff-edit-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;}
.staff-doc-box{grid-column:1/-1;background:#fffbeb;padding:15px;border-radius:8px;border:1px dashed #f59e0b;display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
@media (max-width:900px){.staff-edit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.staff-edit-modal{width:98vw;padding:16px;border-radius:18px;}.staff-edit-modal-head{flex-direction:column;}.staff-edit-modal-close{align-self:flex-end;}}
/* 正職人員資料庫分頁優化 */
.ft-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 18px;}
.ft-tab-btn{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#fff;color:#334155;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.05);}
.ft-tab-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);}
.ft-tab-btn.active{background:#059669;border-color:#059669;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(5,150,105,.18);}
.ft-panel{display:none;}
.ft-panel.active{display:block;}
.ft-split-note{background:#ecfdf5;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;color:#065f46;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.7;}
.ft-edit-banner{display:none;background:#fff7ed;border:1px solid #fdba74;border-left:5px solid #f97316;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;color:#9a3412;font-weight:800;}
.ft-sub-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.ft-list-box{background:#fff;padding:18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;}
/* 公司排班管理分頁版：保留原始快速手打、月時段總覽、點格彈窗 */
.schedule-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 16px;}
.schedule-tab-btn{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#fff;color:#334155;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.05);}
.schedule-tab-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);}
.schedule-tab-btn.active{background:#2563eb;border-color:#2563eb;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(37,99,235,.18);}
.schedule-tab-panel{display:none;}
.schedule-tab-panel.active{display:block;}
.schedule-tab-note{background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#1e3a8a;font-weight:800;line-height:1.7;}
.schedule-tab-note b{color:#1d4ed8;}
.schedule-tab-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#0f172a;margin:0 0 12px;}
/* 排班異動紀錄 */
.change-badge{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;}
.change-normal{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border:1px solid #bbf7d0;}
.change-staff{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;border:1px solid #fecaca;}
.change-client{background:#e0f2fe;color:#075985;border:1px solid #bae6fd;}
.change-company{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border:1px solid #fde68a;}
.change-void{background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;}
.change-modal-backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);z-index:100000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;overflow:auto;}
.change-modal{width:min(720px,96vw);background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 25px 80px rgba(15,23,42,.35);padding:24px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;}
.change-modal h3{margin:0;color:#0f172a;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;}
.change-modal-sub{font-size:13px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;margin:4px 0 16px;line-height:1.7;}
.change-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:16px;}
.change-form-grid label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#475569;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:5px;}
.change-form-grid input,.change-form-grid select,.change-form-grid textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;font-size:13px;}
.change-form-grid textarea{min-height:76px;resize:vertical;}.change-full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.change-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;}
.schedule-mini-change{background:#7c3aed;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;margin-right:6px;}
.change-kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:12px 0 18px;}
.change-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.03);}
.change-kpi .label{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;font-weight:900;}.change-kpi .num{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#0f172a;line-height:1.25;}
@media(max-width:800px){.change-form-grid,.change-kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.change-full{grid-column:auto;}}
/* 修正：排班異動紀錄獨立頁面顯示 */
#page-schedule_changes.active{display:block!important;background:#fff!important;border-radius:12px!important;padding:30px!important;box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.05)!important;border:1px solid #f1f5f9!important;}
/* ===== 人事員工區：左側選單大分類整理 ===== */
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-group,
.sidebar-nav .hr-subgroup{
margin:4px 0;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-title,
.sidebar-nav .hr-sub-title{
width:100%;
border:0;
background:transparent;
color:#475569;
font-weight:900;
text-align:left;
padding:13px 18px;
cursor:pointer;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
gap:8px;
font-size:14px;
border-radius:0;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-title:hover,
.sidebar-nav .hr-sub-title:hover{
background:#f1f5f9;
color:#1d4ed8;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-title .left,
.sidebar-nav .hr-sub-title .left{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:10px;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-title .chev,
.sidebar-nav .hr-sub-title .chev{
transition:transform .2s ease;
font-size:12px;
opacity:.75;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-group.open > .hr-menu-title .chev,
.sidebar-nav .hr-subgroup.open > .hr-sub-title .chev{
transform:rotate(90deg);
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-submenu,
.sidebar-nav .hr-submenu-2{
display:none;
list-style:none;
margin:0;
padding:0;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-group.open > .hr-submenu,
.sidebar-nav .hr-subgroup.open > .hr-submenu-2{
display:block;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-submenu a{
padding-left:38px!important;
font-size:13px;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-submenu-2 a{
padding-left:58px!important;
font-size:13px;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-menu-group.open > .hr-menu-title{
background:#eef6ff;
color:#1d4ed8;
}
.sidebar-nav .hr-subgroup.open > .hr-sub-title{
background:#f8fafc;
color:#1d4ed8;
}
/* ===== 人事儀表板：提醒區塊快速切換 ===== */
.hr-dashboard-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0 14px 0;grid-column:1/-1;}
.hr-dashboard-tabs button{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#fff;color:#334155;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(15,23,42,.05);}
.hr-dashboard-tabs button.active{background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-color:#2563eb;}
.hr-reminder-panel{display:none!important;grid-column:1/-1;}
.hr-reminder-panel.active{display:block!important;}
/* ===== 人事儀表板：四個提醒按鈕切換 ===== */
.hr-dashboard-tabs{
display:flex;
gap:10px;
flex-wrap:wrap;
margin:12px 0 14px 0;
grid-column:1/-1;
}
.hr-dashboard-tabs button{
border:1px solid #cbd5e1;
background:#fff;
color:#334155;
border-radius:12px;
padding:10px 14px;
font-weight:900;
cursor:pointer;
box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
}
.hr-dashboard-tabs button.active{
background:#2563eb;
color:#fff;
border-color:#2563eb;
}
.hr-reminder-panel{
display:none!important;
grid-column:1/-1;
}
.hr-reminder-panel.active{
display:block!important;
}
/* ===== 營業管理區不要顯示人事提醒區塊 ===== */
.workspace-business .ws-hr,
.workspace-sales .ws-hr,
.workspace-business .hr-reminder-panel.active,
.workspace-sales .hr-reminder-panel.active{
display:none!important;
}
.workspace-hr .hr-reminder-panel.active{
display:block!important;
}
/* ===== 對帳單/PDF：只隱藏排班異動彈窗，不改版面比例 ===== */
@media print{
#scheduleChangeModal,
.change-modal-backdrop,
.change-modal,
[id^="sch_change_modal"]{
display:none!important;
visibility:hidden!important;
}
}
#pdf-export-box #scheduleChangeModal,
#pdf-export-box .change-modal-backdrop,
#pdf-export-box .change-modal,
#pdf-export-box [id^="sch_change_modal"]{
display:none!important;
visibility:hidden!important;
}
/* ===== 對帳單 A4 友善版面 ===== */
.statement-a4{
width:100%;
max-width:720px;
margin:0 auto;
color:#334155;
font-family:"Microsoft JhengHei",Arial,sans-serif;
font-size:13px;
}
.statement-title{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
gap:10px;
color:#16a34a;
font-size:26px;
font-weight:900;
margin-bottom:12px;
}
.statement-logo{
width:46px!important;
height:46px!important;
object-fit:contain;
}
.statement-line{
height:3px;
background:#16a34a;
margin:0 0 18px 0;
}
.statement-info-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1.4fr .9fr .9fr;
gap:10px;
align-items:start;
margin-bottom:14px;
}
.statement-info{
line-height:1.8;
padding:6px 2px;
}
.statement-small-box{
border:1px solid #dbeafe;
background:#f8fafc;
border-radius:8px;
padding:8px;
min-height:auto;
}
.statement-small-box .box-title{
font-weight:900;
color:#334155;
border-bottom:1px solid #cbd5e1;
padding-bottom:4px;
margin-bottom:4px;
}
.statement-small-box table{
width:100%;
border-collapse:collapse;
margin:0!important;
font-size:12px;
}
.statement-small-box td{
border:none!important;
padding:2px 0!important;
text-align:left!important;
}
.statement-summary{
width:100%;
table-layout:fixed;
border-collapse:collapse;
margin:12px 0 16px 0;
}
.statement-summary td{
border:1px solid #cbd5e1;
padding:10px 4px;
text-align:center;
background:#f8fafc;
}
.statement-summary td:nth-child(3){background:#fff1f2;}
.statement-summary td:nth-child(4){background:#fff7ed;}
.statement-summary td:nth-child(5){background:#ecfdf5;}
.statement-summary span{
display:block;
font-size:12px;
color:#64748b;
margin-bottom:5px;
}
.statement-summary strong{
display:block;
font-size:20px;
color:#0f172a;
}
.statement-detail{
width:100%;
table-layout:fixed;
border-collapse:collapse;
font-size:12px;
}
.statement-detail th,
.statement-detail td{
border:1px solid #cbd5e1;
padding:7px 5px;
text-align:center;
word-break:break-word;
}
.statement-detail th{
background:#f1f5f9;
color:#334155;
font-weight:900;
}
.statement-detail th:nth-child(1), .statement-detail td:nth-child(1){width:22%;}
.statement-detail th:nth-child(2), .statement-detail td:nth-child(2){width:20%;}
.statement-detail th:nth-child(3), .statement-detail td:nth-child(3){width:24%;}
.statement-detail th:nth-child(4), .statement-detail td:nth-child(4){width:17%;}
.statement-detail th:nth-child(5), .statement-detail td:nth-child(5){width:17%;}
.statement-period-note{
margin-top:12px;
padding:10px 12px;
border:1px solid #fde68a;
border-left:4px solid #f59e0b;
border-radius:8px;
background:#fffbeb;
color:#713f12;
line-height:1.7;
page-break-inside:avoid;
}
.statement-period-note-title{font-weight:900;color:#92400e;margin-bottom:4px;}
.statement-period-note-text{white-space:normal;word-break:break-word;}
@media print{
.statement-a4{max-width:720px!important;}
}
</style>
<script>
/* ===== 員工手機入口：在畫面繪製前立即隱藏舊版內容 ===== */
(function () {
try {
var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
var isStaffApp = params.get('staffApp') === '1';
if (!isStaffApp) return;
document.documentElement.classList.add('qyj-staff-fast-start');
var style = document.createElement('style');
style.id = 'qyjStaffFastStartStyle';
style.textContent = `
html.qyj-staff-fast-start body > * {
visibility: hidden !important;
}
html.qyj-staff-fast-start #mobileStaffApp,
html.qyj-staff-fast-start #mobileStaffApp *,
html.qyj-staff-fast-start #toast {
visibility: visible !important;
}
html.qyj-staff-fast-start body {
background: #f4f7fb !important;
}
`;
document.head.appendChild(style);
} catch (error) {
console.warn('員工快速入口預隱藏失敗：', error);
}
})();
</script>
